prompt: Create a soft pastel anime close-up portrait of a cute chibi-style girl with bubblegum pink hair in fluffy twin tails, large sleepy blue eyes, a tiny pouting mouth, and heavy rosy blush across both cheeks. She rests her chin on one hand with a shy, dreamy expression, wearing a loose white long-sleeve top with a frilled cuff and a visible shoulder cutout. Add exactly 1 pale yellow star hair clip on the right side of her hair, exactly 1 small white kitten with pink ears sleeping on top of her head, and exactly 2 glowing yellow sparkle stars floating to the left of her head. Use a warm indoor background with soft brown and cream tones, shallow depth of field, gentle bloom, glossy highlights on the hair and eyes, delicate line art, rounded proportions, kawaii Japanese MV-thumbnail aesthetic, square 1:1 composition, cropped close around the face and upper shoulders. Keep the mood sweet, sleepy, innocent, and pastel; no hard shadows, no realistic rendering, no extra characters, no readable text or watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张柔和粉彩风格的动漫特写肖像，主角是一位可爱的 Q 版少女，留着 泡泡糖粉色 的蓬松双马尾，拥有大而惺忪的蓝色眼睛、小巧的嘟嘟嘴，双颊泛着浓郁的红晕。她单手托腮，表情羞涩而梦幻，身穿一件宽松的白色长袖上衣，袖口带有荷叶边，肩膀处有镂空设计。在她的右侧头发上添加 1 个淡黄色星星发夹，头顶趴着 1 只粉色耳朵的小白猫正在睡觉，左侧悬浮着 2 颗发光的黄色闪烁星星。背景采用温暖的室内风格，色调为柔和的棕色和奶油色，浅景深，柔光效果，头发和眼睛带有光泽感，线条细腻，比例圆润，呈现可爱的日系 MV 缩略图美学，采用 1:1 正方形构图，画面裁剪至面部及上肩部。保持甜美、慵懒、纯真的氛围；无硬阴影，无写实渲染，无额外角色，无任何可读文字或水印。
